objective: Improve the Night map: a dense, atmospheric, readable festival shrine at night, with new Blender props, terrain ground, a lighting pass and ambient VFX, keeping combat untouched.
acceptance_criteria: 15 new props exist as Blender scripts, FBX and PNG in assets/night/, manifest entries and nil-id NightAssets entries; map_props_sheet.png is reviewed
With nil ids the game runs: a run starts, wave 1 spawns, no new script errors
The walkable surface stays at the measured y = 1 across the courtyard and pond, so player height against enemy hover and the Y hit bands is unchanged (cobblestone paths read 1.2)
Spawn, gates, boss pit, stage and bridge collision are unchanged; decoration is ghosted and spot() refuses the fighting floor, the pit and the gates
Register rows read Pending upload until the Director runs the upload
verification: lune run tests/run, selene src tests, stylua --check, rojo build night.project.json, node tools/validate-tasks.mjs; Studio playtest with nil ids and floor height sampled against the unmodified build; after the upload, playtest with the generated NightAssets.luau and review stair direction, castle, waterfall and mountain placement, which could not be seen before upload
notes: Fixes found on the way, all visual: uploaded models faced backwards (yaw), the leaderboard text was covered, and the pit, pond and paths were buried under the lawn. Open for the owner: Enemies.luau assumes the ground is y = 0 while players stand at y = 1; this task keeps y = 1. Enemies.luau:155 places enemy meshes at yaw 0, so they may share the facing flip; not checked. Upload is run by the Director after merge. Director review (real models): stairs rebuilt as one flight, waterfall relit, mountain arcs tapered. sando_stairs and mountain_range must be re-uploaded before merge: until then the old stair mesh is scaled to the new manifest height and shows as giant wedges. The reviewed screenshots of those two use the new geometry through a scratch stand-in, without the baked texture, so review them again after the upload.
